Its exact full distribution over orientations resolves all thresholds, not just an expectation. Its Haar mean quantifies a distinct and practically relevant direction-first sampling protocol, providing a reproducible benchmark and isolating the sampling-order distinction in section stereology. This is structurally informative, not an arbitrary numeric slice.
